title: Multi-Window Session Handling
outcome: Use localStorage for window_id (shared across tabs) with BroadcastChannel for cross-window communication. Multi-tab support with cross-browser conflict detection.
rationale: Multiple tabs in same browser share session via shared window_id. Different browsers/devices have different window_ids triggering conflict detection. Real-time sync via BroadcastChannel (no polling).

risk.acceptance: BroadcastChannel not in IE11 but modern browsers only. localStorage shared state tested extensively.

scenarios: Same browser, multiple tabs: Share session (no conflict)
Different browsers/devices: Conflict detection and dialog
Session transfer: Graceful ownership transfer between tabs
